blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: If the wind dies down, we'll go.
exercises.why: **стихнуть → стихнет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: It will damage the crops.
exercises.why: **нанести → нанесёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Patience and hard work will conquer all.
exercises.why: **перетереть → перетрут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Вы не ___ (вдеть) мне нитку в иголку?
exercises.prompt: Could you thread the needle for me?
exercises.why: **вдеть → вденете** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Начавшись с чипирования скота, это ___ (закончиться) электронной идентификацией каждого человека.
exercises.prompt: When you start putting chips in cattle, you end up practicing the electronic identification of each human being.
exercises.why: **закончиться → закончится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Компания, хотя и с некоторыми исключениями, очень хорошо ___ (утилизировать) ресурсы.
exercises.prompt: The company, although with some exceptions, usually utilizes its resources very well.
exercises.why: **утилизировать → утилизирует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Ничто не ___ (сравниться) со стаканом натурального свежевыжатого сока.
exercises.prompt: There's nothing like a glass of natural, freshly squeezed juice.
exercises.why: **сравниться → сравнится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: My phone is about to die.
exercises.why: **вырубиться → вырубится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Come what may, I won't change my mind.
exercises.why: **отступиться → отступлюсь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'm not going to be afraid again.
exercises.why: **испугаться → испугаюсь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll never leave you.
exercises.why: **бросить → брошу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Начни прямо сейчас, и ты их ___ (нагнать).
exercises.prompt: Start right now, and you'll catch up with them.
exercises.why: **нагнать → нагонишь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Your readers will thank you.
exercises.why: **поблагодарить → поблагодарят** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: May God reward you.
exercises.why: **вознаградить → вознаградит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You can't stop people from talking.
exercises.why: **заткнуть → заткнёшь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: How are we going to get the piano upstairs?
exercises.why: **затащить → затащим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Put the top of your car down.
exercises.why: **опустить → Опустите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'll teach you a lesson!
exercises.why: **показать → покажу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'd rather stay home and knit.
exercises.why: **повязать → повяжу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's move over to that table.
exercises.why: **пересесть → пересядем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
